rows.label: Strict no-BAND fusion, frozen score + E1

table_arithmetic.scope: Only seven-cell TP/FP/FN/P/R/F1 rows; not exhaustive prose/source validation

limitations: Posthoc sensitivity, same repeatedly examined route, no new data or physical truth. Annotation-ID canonical first-supported-camera class convention retained. Group hit uses ANY member. Per-stratum matched-TP bounds condition on maximum total TP; bounds across strata are not jointly additive. FP categories are annotation-overlap proxies, not physical causes. Supplied XML visibility is not measured FOV/occlusion. No threshold selection, no inference or supervised fitting, no E2E benchmark.
